_notes: The test topics. Each test class carries [Trait("Topic", NAME)] with one of these names. tools/run_tests.py runs the topics asked for together in one test run (or each in its own with --separate), and with --changed only those a change can affect, as tests/topic-map.json (made by --map) says.

all: files whose change runs every topic (the UQM maths and data everything uses, the test project's shared files, and the two files outside the code that tests read: the design's content notice and the game's project file).

weight: roughly how long the topic takes, so with --separate the heaviest start first. alone: with --separate, the topic has timing-sensitive tests, so it runs after the others, by itself (in one run, xUnit's own collection does that).
